heading1.title_general: Blateman & Bobine - The Comic of the Super-Zeros

facebook.facebook_post: Publication from Facebook Vincent Henin - Vhenin

characters.characters_introduction: Hello, I’m Blateman! I’m Batman’s cousin—the real one. He went to great lengths to keep my existence a secret! But it was all in vain: thanks to artist Vhenin and comic book writer Tarek, I’m stepping out of the shadows… for the best, and for a good laugh! Follow my adventures—you won’t regret it…
characters.characters_testimony: Blateman is a hilarious and unique character. His adventures are always full of surprises and laughter. I highly recommend following his escapades! - An enthusiastic fan
characters.characters_description-bobine: Bobine is a kid with yellow hair and a rather prominent set of teeth—hardly the classic "pretty boy" look for a hero! But he’s sharp, occasionally a bit cunning, and, above all, resourceful and perceptive. His motivation knows no bounds; he hopes to learn the ropes of the superhero trade from his mentor, Blateman… Or perhaps it’s the other way around—could Bobine actually be teaching Blateman a thing or two? Sometimes the student surpasses the master! The "B & B" duo is pure dynamite—the perfect combination to take you on wild adventures, keep you laughing, and whisk you away on a series of colorful, action-packed escapades.
characters.characters_description-blateman: Blateman is to adventure what Batman is to the bat… Well, make of that what you will. Blateman is a superhero who often flirts with being a super-zero! Despite his extraordinary powers and the tricks he keeps stashed in his "Blat-pouches," he frequently has to rely on his assistant, Bobine, to clean up his blunders. The poor, high-achieving cockroach—she’s got four left hands, after all…
